[P4] 那是一个星期二的清晨，与平时没什么不同。
像往常一样，
5:57，
巴士司机喝完茶。
像往常一样，
5:58，
巴士司机穿好外套。
还是像往常一样，
5:59，
巴士司机登上双层巴士。
六点整，他准时发动引擎，驾车驶离公共汽车总站。

[P5] 每天如此，
系着宽大的红色领带的先生
在环岛站上车。

每天如此，
推着婴儿车的女士
在图书馆站上车。

还是每天如此，
叽叽喳喳的孩子们
在幸运草站上车。

“唉！”巴士司机轻轻地叹了一口气。每天都重复同样的生活，
他有些厌倦了。“要是能乘上那只热气球，”他想，“我们就能
飘到天上去，飘得远远的，飘到任何想去的地方。”

正想着，巴士司机注意到一条
以往他从没见过的小路。
“这条路通向哪儿呢？”他暗自琢磨。

[P6] 司机转动方向盘，双层巴士驶入小路。
这并不是他日常行车的路线。太令人兴奋了！不久，
车子渐渐远离了城市，缓缓行驶在乡间小路上。

“请问，”红领带先生说，“我们这是要开到哪儿去呀？”
“我不知道，”巴士司机欢快地回答，“哪儿都能去！'

双层巴士继续向前行驶。车子驶入那些他们
从没去过的、不同以往的城镇，镇里有他们
从没去过的、不同以往的公共汽车站。
这真是一场大冒险！

您想搭车吗？
这车要开到哪儿去呀？
哪儿都能去！
好呀！

没过多久，双层巴士上坐满了
兴高采烈的乘客，尽管他们并
不知道要去哪儿。

[P7] 过了整整一天，双层巴士抵达海边。
“没路可开了。”司机略带伤感地通知乘客们。

“我们可不能现在就停，”推婴儿车的女士说，
“去坐渡轮吧。”

于是，车子开上了渡轮。

“这车要开到哪儿去呀？”渡轮上的一群船员们问道。
“哪儿都能去！”巴士司机回答，“我们正在冒险呢！”
“能让我们搭车吗？”船员们问。
“当然欢迎！”巴士司机回答，“不过，我们的车子满员了。”
船员们陷入了沉思。

[P8] 他们卖力地工作了整整一夜，
敲敲打打、叮叮当当、钻孔打洞……

第二天早晨，开上岸的是一辆
闪闪发光的三层巴士。

镇上开来一辆大型巴士的
消息传开了……

很快，三层巴士再次满员！
乘客们又齐心协力，
开始建造巴士的第四层。

[P9] 四层巴士里洋溢着欢声笑语，
直到……

“没问题，”学生们说，
“我们有办法！”
他们想出一个穿过（并跨越！）
大桥的妙招。

“这下，再没有什么能阻挡我们前进啦！”乘客们欢呼。
紧接着，巴士的第五层、第六层和第七层也逐级搭建起来。

[P10] 巴士一路前行。
当心那辆巴士！
要搭车吗？
车子开得越远，车厢长得越高！
哇哦！
这车要开到哪儿去呀？
哪儿都能去！
那辆巴士来了！

[P11] 两个月之后，巴士穿越一个气候异常
炎热的国家。因此，第三十层车厢被
建成了一座游泳池，池水还挺深！

六个月过去了，巴士的高度超过了最高的摩天大楼。

[P12] 乘客们出发
一年之后，这辆巴士
已经高达100层。人们为此
举行了一场盛大的庆典，
尽情欢笑，彻夜
无眠。

[P13] 就在庆典过后的第二天，
车子开始发出怪声。

“哦，天哪！”巴士司机说。

咯楞楞！
咯楞楞！

又过了一天，
发动机开始冒起烟来。

“天哪，哦，天哪！”
巴士司机大喊。

又再过了一天，
发动机盖子直接炸开了。

“天哪！哦，天哪！哦，天哪！”
巴士司机尖叫起来。

可怜的巴士出了故障！

[P14] 乘客们一个个走出巴士，你看看我、我看看你。
“我们现在去哪儿？”他们问司机。
“哪儿都不能去了。”司机略带伤感地回答。

忽然，有位听觉特别灵敏的乘客问：

什么声音？
没听到啊！
我好像听见了！

上面有人吗？

所有乘客一齐抬头……

[P15] “要搭车吗？”
热气球里的人大声呼喊。

[P17] 乘客们全都乘着热气球飘上了天，
飘得远远的，飘到任何他们想去的地方……

因为，这本来就是一场大冒险啊！

a journey that follows your heart—
a one-of-a-kind global bus,
setting off now!

Do you want
a ride?

Bus

[P4] It was a Tuesday morning, no different from usual.
As usual,
5:57,
the bus driver finished his tea.
As usual,
5:58,
the bus driver put on his coat.
Still as usual,
5:59,
the bus driver boarded the double-decker bus.
At exactly six o'clock, he started the engine and drove away from the bus terminal.

[P5] Every day,
the man with the wide red tie
gets on at Roundabout Station.

Every day,
the woman pushing the stroller
gets on at Library Station.

Still every day,
the chattering children
get on at Lucky Clover Station.

"Sigh!" The bus driver sighed softly. Every day was the same,
and he was getting tired of it. "If only we could get on that hot air balloon," he thought, "we could float up into the sky, float far away, float to any place we wanted to go."

Just then, the bus driver noticed a small road
he had never seen before.
"Where does this road lead?" he wondered to himself.

[P6] The driver turned the steering wheel, and the double-decker bus drove onto a small road.
This was not his usual route. How exciting! Soon, the bus gradually left the city and slowly traveled along a country road.

"Excuse me," said Mr. Red Tie, "where are we going?"
"I don't know," the bus driver replied cheerfully, "we can go anywhere!"

The double-decker bus continued forward. It drove into towns they had never been to before, towns with bus stops they had never seen before.
This was truly a great adventure!

Do you want a ride?
Where is this bus going?
We can go anywhere!
Yes, please!

Soon, the double-decker bus was full of
excited passengers, even though they didn't
know where they were going.

[P7] After a whole day, the double-decker bus arrived at the seaside.
"There's no road left," the driver told the passengers with a hint of sadness.

"We can't stop now," said the lady pushing the stroller,
"Let's take the ferry instead."

So, the bus drove onto the ferry.

"Where is this bus going?" asked a group of sailors on the ferry.
"Anywhere we want!" the bus driver replied, "We're on an adventure!"
"Can we get a ride?" the sailors asked.
"Of course!" the bus driver answered, "But our bus is full."
The sailors fell into thought.

[P8] They worked hard all night long,
hammering, clanging, drilling holes...

The next morning, a shining three-story bus arrived on shore.

News spread around town that a large bus had arrived...

Soon, the three-story bus was full again!
The passengers worked together once more,
starting to build the fourth floor of the bus.

[P9] The four-story bus was filled with laughter and joy,
until...

"No problem," the students said,
"We've got a plan!"
They came up with a clever way to go through (and over!)
the bridge.

"Now, nothing can stop us from moving forward!" the passengers cheered.
Next, the fifth, sixth, and seventh floors of the bus were built one by one.

[P10] The bus travels on.
Watch out for that bus!
Would you like a ride?
The farther the bus goes, the taller the carriage gets!
Wow!
Where is this bus going?
Anywhere we want!
There comes the bus!

[P11] Two months later, the bus crossed a country with unusually hot weather. Therefore, the thirtieth floor was turned into a swimming pool, and the water was quite deep!

Six months had passed, and the bus had grown taller than the tallest skyscraper.

[P12] Passengers set off
One year later, this bus
had reached 100 stories high. People held a grand celebration for this,
laughing and enjoying themselves, staying up all night.

[P13] The day after the celebration,
the bus started making strange noises.

“Oh, my!” said the bus driver.

Clunk! Clunk!

The next day,
the engine began to smoke.

“Oh, my, oh, my!”
the bus driver shouted.

The day after that,
the engine cover blew right off.

“Oh my! Oh my! Oh my!”
the bus driver screamed.

Poor bus had broken down!

[P14] Passengers stepped out of the bus one by one, looking at each other.
"Where are we going now?" they asked the driver.
"Nowhere," the driver replied, sounding a bit sad.

Suddenly, a passenger with especially sharp hearing asked:

What sound?
I don't hear anything!
I think I heard something!

Is anyone up there?

All passengers looked up together...

[P15] "Want a ride?"
Someone in the hot air balloon shouts loudly.

[P17] The passengers all climbed into hot air balloons and floated up into the sky,
floating far and wide, to any place they wished to go……

Because, this was always a great adventure!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《100层的巴士》的封面及封底，展示了高耸入云、层层叠叠的巴士，以及邀请读者搭车的文字，营造出奇幻冒险的氛围。
[P2] 本页展示了一幅广阔的乡村风景，画面中有连绵的丘陵、田野、树木、羊群和远处的城镇与雪山，整体色调以蓝色为主，营造出宁静而开阔的氛围。
[P3] 本页为绘本《100层的巴士》的版权页和扉页，左侧包含献词、图书在版编目（CIP）数据、出版信息及出版社联系方式，右侧为书名“100层的巴士”及作者、译者信息，下方有一排排队等候上车的卡通人物，营造出即将启程的氛围。
[P4] 本页描绘了巴士司机在星期二清晨按部就班地准备上班的过程：喝完茶、穿好外套、登上双层巴士，并在六点准时驶离总站，画面展现了城市清晨的景象和司机的日常routine。
[P5] 本页描绘了巴士司机每日重复的乘客和路线，他感到厌倦并向往自由，同时发现了一条从未见过的小路，引发了他的好奇。
[P6] 巴士司机驶入一条从未走过的乡间小路，乘客们感到兴奋，司机表示可以去任何地方，巴士载着不知目的地的乘客驶向陌生城镇，开启了一场大冒险。
[P7] 双层巴士抵达海边后，因无路可走而登上渡轮，船员们好奇询问并希望搭车，但司机表示已满员，船员们陷入沉思。
[P8] 巴士在渡轮的帮助下抵达岸边，成为一辆闪闪发光的三层巴士，消息传开后，镇上居民纷纷前来乘坐，乘客们又开始齐心协力建造巴士的第四层。
[P9] 巴士在穿过大桥时遇到障碍，学生们想出办法让巴士成功跨越，乘客们欢呼雀跃，随后巴士继续扩建，第五、六、七层被逐级搭建起来。
[P10] 本页以地图形式展现了巴士一路前行的旅程，随着行驶距离增加，巴士不断增高，沿途各地的人们纷纷好奇并希望搭车，体现了巴士冒险旅程的扩展与受欢迎程度。
[P11] 巴士穿越炎热国家后，第三十层被改造成游泳池；六个月后，巴士高度已超过最高摩天大楼。
[P12] 一年后，巴士已高达100层，人们为此举行盛大庆典，彻夜欢庆。
[P13] 庆典后的第二天，巴士开始发出怪声，随后发动机冒烟、盖子炸开，最终彻底故障，司机和乘客们惊慌失措。
[P14] 巴士因故障停在荒漠中，乘客们纷纷下车，困惑于接下来的去向。突然有人听见奇怪的声音，大家抬头望向高耸入云的巴士顶层，好奇是否有其他人存在。
[P15] 画面展示了一座高耸入云、层层叠叠的巴士，天空中一个热气球里的人向巴士喊话，询问是否可以搭车，暗示巴士的旅程仍在继续，且吸引了新的关注者。
[P16] 画面展示了一座高耸入云、层层叠叠的巴士，其结构复杂，包含多种房屋、设施和活动场景。巴士停在荒漠中，底部有乘客聚集，天空中一个热气球里的人向巴士喊话，询问是否可以搭车，暗示旅程仍在继续。
[P17] 巴士故障后，乘客们乘坐热气球飞向天空，各自前往想去的地方，故事以一场充满想象力的大冒险收尾。
[P18] 画面展现了一幅广阔的黄昏风景，远处有山脉、城市和农田，近处有蒲公英和两个坐在草地上的小人，天空中一个热气球正飞过，整体氛围宁静而充满想象力，暗示旅程的延续与新的开始。
